slideDifferences.nativeText:
When we talk about  weather we do not only use simple present. We can also use will. Check the following examples.
TO CONSIDER

Will is used to state future. 
Verbs go in simple form after using will. 
Future Time phrases are also needed.
Adverbs also help to state meaning.
Will – Future
It will rain soon. It is cloudy.
Will it rain soon?
It is cold; it will probably snow later.
Will it probably snow later?
Go fresh, it will be sunny at the beach.
Will it be sunny at the beach?

texts: Sean, I will pick you up in some minutes.
Ok, almost ready. Do I need any sweater or jacket?
It will probably be cold since it is rainy,
Ok, I will take my hoody. I am ready.
You know this new gamers pub they all talk about?
Of course, I do. Wait… Is that where we are going?
Yes, I will take you there as a birthday present.
Oh man! I will wear my lucky jeans… I will have so much fun. Thanks!
Not to worry, I am almost there. Hey! You owe me big for my birthday.
I will get you a date with Nancy, I promise.
Magnificent, we will be even then.
